## KultrDL for iOS

The first release of KultrDL on the iPhone, in the design of Kultr for iOS.

- **Search** YouTube Music, YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Apple Music, Deezer and Spotify, or paste a link from any of them, Tidal, Qobuz or Amazon Music.
- **Play** with a queue, the lock screen, Control Center and AirPlay; the colours follow the artwork of what's playing.
- **Download** as FLAC, MP3, AAC, Opus, ALAC, WAV or Ogg Vorbis, with tags and cover art. Downloads show in the Files app.
- **Send** downloads to your NAS or computer over SFTP, FTPS or FTP, into Artist or Artist/Album folders.
- **Keep** favourites, saved tracks, playlists and your listening history, and back them up — the backup opens in KultrDL for Android too.
- **No yt-dlp or ffmpeg needed:** streams, YouTube's challenges and conversion are built in, and YouTube's clients update themselves (Settings → Engine).

## Install

Download **KultrDL.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore**. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/KultrDL_iOS/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` to AltStore or SideStore, and new versions arrive as updates.
